yoke.column.name: Yoke (roll / pitch)
yoke.column.note: yoke handle hub (shaft mount behind the centre cover); axes from the base

unplaced.yoke.button.1: generic placeholder without an input; no numbering sheet, not identifiable among the handle's controls

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-12), yoke handle seen from the pilot's side (front), left horn with a rocker/thumb-wheel module and a side button, right horn with a hat/encoder module and a thumb button; base not in the photo
mappingSource: catalog (product page https://virpil-controls.eu/b-jet-yoke-handle.html, user manual https://support.virpil.com/en/support/solutions/articles/47001286739-b-jet-yoke-user-manual); no numbering sheet published, the catalog has no inputs for this handle
note: the catalog lists only a generic 'yoke button 1' with no input; the handle has several controls (left module, left side button, right hat/encoder module, right thumb button) and none can be identified as 'button 1' -> not placed. yoke.column marked on the central hub where the handle meets the yoke shaft (the shaft/base is not in the photo); roll/pitch come from the Vector base.
